name: Match Lifecycle
description: The state machine that owns a match's shape: lobby, deployment, live phases, endgame, podium. It is deliberately thin — each phase's rules live in the component that owns them (world.zone_collapse shrinks, combat.downed_revive decides who is still standing) — and this component only sequences the phases and decides, from defeat and bleed-out counts, when one competitor or squad remains. Placement is awarded here because 'where you finished' is a match-scoped fact; social.leaderboard consumes progression.placementAwarded for anything persistent, and this component keeps no history of its own. Built on utility.behavior_fsm rather than a private switch statement so the phase graph is inspectable, debuggable, and moddable like every other state machine in the library.

inputs.name: minPlayersToStart
inputs.description: Lobby population required before the countdown begins. Below this the lobby waits indefinitely; a dev or test harness can set 1, but the shipped default should never let a match start uncontested.

inputs.name: lobbyCountdownSeconds
inputs.description: Time from reaching minPlayersToStart to deployment. Long enough for late joiners to load in, short enough that the lobby itself never becomes the game.

inputs.name: endgamePhaseThreshold
inputs.description: Zone phase index at which the match is considered endgame. The lifecycle only labels the transition — what endgame MEANS (faster ticks, final-circle rules) belongs to world.zone_collapse's config.

inputs.name: podiumDurationSeconds
inputs.description: How long the results phase holds before teardown. The podium is the match's only moment of pure ceremony; cutting it short makes 20 minutes of tension end in a loading spinner.

outputs.name: currentPhase
outputs.description: One of lobby, deployment, live, endgame, podium. Every other match-scoped component keys off this rather than maintaining its own clock.

outputs.name: competitorsRemaining
outputs.description: Live count of players or squads still in. The victory check is this reaching one — there is no separate win condition to keep in sync.

outputs.name: isMatchOver
outputs.description: True from the moment a winner is decided through podium teardown.
